Each hop was independently verified as a real directed event at the stated timestamp (steps 05-09). Inter-hop waits are 269, 264, 296 and 388 units — all strictly increasing and all within the 600-unit limit (max used 388). Confounder checks: (a) the intermediaries are not hubs — 851, 282, 103, 1622 have only 4-8 events each in the window (step_10), and endpoints 1017/1593 have 22/19 events with no repeats (step_03), so the path is not an artifact of high-degree mixing; (b) the relation is directional — no time-respecting route exists from 1593 back to 1017 under the same constraint (step_11), ruling out a symmetric/coincidental connection; (c) the cascade is not a product of a dense activity burst — only 144 of 8050 events fall in the 60727-61944 span (step_13); (d) the chain is tight but not arbitrarily so — tightening max_wait to 150 breaks reachability (step_12), confirming the 600-unit budget is what the actual observed gaps require rather than the result being trivially satisfiable. Only one such route exists, so the cascade is genuine but narrow.
